class.name: XboxUserSignOutDeferral
class.brief_description: Owner of a single GDK user sign-out deferral handle.
class.description: Returned by [method XboxUsers.acquire_sign_out_deferral]. Holding a [XboxUserSignOutDeferral] asks the platform to delay completing a pending sign-out so the title can flush per-user state such as a save. Release it as soon as that work is done — the platform only waits for a short, bounded window. The handle is closed via [code]XUserCloseSignOutDeferralHandle[/code], which is independent of the GDK runtime lifecycle, so [method release] is always safe even after [method GDK.shutdown].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while this wrapper still owns an open deferral handle.

method.name: release
method.description: Closes the deferral handle and lets the pending sign-out complete. Idempotent; calling [method release] more than once is safe.
